zh-CN.title: 聊天快捷操作
items: 快捷按钮以透明毛玻璃悬浮在消息上方，不再压缩聊天区域
私聊和群聊独立配置、拖动排序，私聊移除在线状态
简化个性化入口并提前展示，整理详情中的独立操作分组

en.title: Chat quick actions
items: Translucent blurred buttons float over messages without reducing the conversation area
Separate direct and group layouts support drag ordering; direct chats no longer show presence
A concise Personalization entry appears earlier, with cleaner standalone action groups in details
